entities.name: Geetra
entities.description: Precognitive mage of Ravnica who serves the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild that pardoned Geetra and employs her.

events.summary: Caught as a teenage thief, Geetra is pardoned on condition she serve the Azorius Senate.
events.quote: Caught while still a teenager, she was pardoned on the condition that she would serve the Azorius Senate instead of facing punishment.

events.summary: Geetra steps into a more visible and respected role as the senate takes interest in precognitive magic.
events.quote: Geetra has stepped into a more visible and respected role, which she has embraced wholeheartedly.

relations.quote: she was pardoned on the condition that she would serve the Azorius Senate
